name: C11_PI_OCTAHEDRON_CORE_MODULATOR_QUANTIFIER_BINDING_V1
purpose: Bind the logical quantifiers of O1/O2 before any execution so that O2 is a genuine falsifier of O1 rather than a merely local core escape.

definitions.Oct_C: The complete graph-only set of all literal induced subgraphs H of authoritative residual C that are isomorphic to K_{2,2,2}.
definitions.Col_L_H: All proper list-respecting colorings phi:H->[4] generated directly from H and the exact current lists.
definitions.Terminal_C_H_phi: After fixing phi on all six vertices of H and applying only the frozen deterministic propagation/normalization stack, every resulting branch/component is closed by CONTRADICTION, L3_READY, or TW3_LIST_READY.
definitions.Escape_C_H_phi: After fixing phi and frozen propagation, the branch is noncontradictory and at least one surviving connected component D is NOT_L3_READY and has tw(D)>3 certified by an explicit frozen forbidden-minor model.

empty_core_semantics.rule: If Col_L(H)=empty, classify H as CORE_UNSAT_GOOD_MODULATOR.
rationale: There is no proper list-respecting assignment to H, hence no full coloring of C can extend through H.
This avoids relying only on vacuous universal quantification while preserving the same logical truth value.
Such an H satisfies the O1 good-core condition and blocks O2 for that C.

per_residual_good_core.formula: GOOD(C) := exists H in Oct(C) such that [CoreUnsat(H) OR for all phi in Col_L(H): Terminal(C,H,phi)].

O1_universal.label: O1_OCTAHEDRON_CORE_TERMINAL_UNIVERSAL
O1_universal.formula: for all authoritative C in scope: GOOD(C).
O1_universal.meaning: Every authoritative literal-octahedron residual has at least one graph-discoverable literal octahedron that is a universal six-vertex modulator to the frozen terminal stack.

local_escape_only.label: LOCAL_CORE_ESCAPE
local_escape_only.formula: exists authoritative C, exists H in Oct(C), exists phi in Col_L(H): Escape(C,H,phi).
local_escape_only.interpretation: This proves only that one specific literal core H is not universal. It MUST NOT falsify O1 because a different H* in the same C may still satisfy GOOD(C).

O2_strong_falsifier.label: O2_OCTAHEDRON_ATTACHMENT_ESCAPE
O2_strong_falsifier.formula: exists authoritative C such that for every H in Oct(C), [Col_L(H) is nonempty AND exists phi_H in Col_L(H): Escape(C,H,phi_H)].
O2_strong_falsifier.equivalence_note: Within the preregistered scope, where Oct(C) is nonempty by definition, this is the proof-carrying negation of GOOD(C) for one authoritative residual C.
O2_strong_falsifier.consequence: No literal octahedron in that C is a universal six-vertex modulator to the frozen {CONTRADICTION,L3_READY,TW3_LIST_READY} stack.

execution_binding.core_enumeration_requirement: For any candidate O2 residual C, exhaustively enumerate the complete set Oct(C) by the frozen graph-only literal-octahedron search.
for_each_H: Enumerate every proper list-respecting phi in Col_L(H), bounded by 4^6=4096 raw assignments.
If Col_L(H)=empty, mark H CORE_UNSAT_GOOD_MODULATOR and O2 immediately fails for this C.
Otherwise O2 requires at least one explicitly preserved defeating phi_H with a complete Escape certificate.
O2_receipt_requires: complete authoritative residual C and exact lists
complete enumeration receipt of every literal H in Oct(C)
for every H, a count/hash or explicit canonical enumeration receipt for Col_L(H)
for every H, one proper list-respecting defeating phi_H
for every H, exact frozen propagation transcript after fixing phi_H
for every H, exact surviving connected D_H
for every H, D_H noncontradictory and NOT_L3_READY with union lists [4]
for every H, explicit frozen forbidden-minor model certifying tw(D_H)>3
independent replay of Oct(C) completeness, each phi_H validity, and each minor model
execution_binding.O1_theorem_requires: A theorem/proof-carrying universal argument that for every authoritative C there exists at least one H in Oct(C) satisfying the good-core condition; finite testing alone is insufficient.
execution_binding.O3_rule: If neither universal O1 authority nor a complete strong-O2 residual is obtained, return O3_GATE_UNRESOLVED. A LOCAL_CORE_ESCAPE may be preserved as supporting evidence under O3 but cannot be promoted to O2.

canonical_selector_alternative.note: A canonical graph-only selector H(C) could make a single bad (H(C),phi) sufficient, but the frozen gate did not define such a selector. Therefore the execution is bound to the existential-good-core / forall-cores-falsifier semantics above.

mandatory_quantifier_controls.name: TWO_CORE_MIXED_CONTROL
mandatory_quantifier_controls.structure: Synthetic residual with two literal octahedra H1,H2.
required_behavior: H1 has at least one escaping proper coloring.
H2 closes for every proper coloring.
Classifier MUST NOT return O2 because H2 is a good core and therefore GOOD(C) remains true.

mandatory_quantifier_controls.name: EMPTY_CORE_COLORING_CONTROL
mandatory_quantifier_controls.structure: Synthetic literal octahedron whose exact lists admit no proper core coloring.
required_behavior: Do not demand an escaping phi from an empty coloring set.
O2 MUST fail for any C containing such a good core.

anti_cheat: A single bad (H,phi) is LOCAL_CORE_ESCAPE only.
Do not stop O2 enumeration after finding the first bad H.
O2 requires defeating every literal H in the same authoritative C.
Do not omit literal octahedron candidates from Oct(C).
Do not choose H or phi with an extension oracle.
Do not treat an empty Col_L(H) as an O2 success.
Do not modify the bound preregistration.
next_action: A later execution authorization must bind both the original preregistration and this quantifier addendum. Stop at O1, strong O2, or O3.
